title: Unique Savory Australian Narutomaki Noodles
description: A rich and snappy Australian dish featuring narutomaki, perfect for a hangover cure, this ovo-vegetarian friendly meal is sure to satisfy your cravings. It combines the flavors of Australia with the uniqueness of Japanese narutomaki.
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and blanch the egg noodles for 3 minutes.
Drain the noodles and set them aside to cool.
In a large skillet, heat the vegetable oil over medium heat and saute the chopped onion until translucent.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute, stirring constantly to prevent burning.
Add the sliced mushrooms to the skillet and cook until they release their moisture and start to brown.
Add the sliced narutomaki to the skillet and stir to combine with the onion and mushroom mixture.
In a small bowl, whisk together the soy sauce and sesame oil, then pour the mixture over the narutomaki and noodles.
Season with salt and pepper to taste, then stir to combine.
Combine the cooked noodles with the narutomaki mixture and toss to coat.
Serve the Unique Savory Australian Narutomaki Noodles hot, garnished with chopped green onions if desired.
